text:
Lia: Heads up — planning a blue->green shift for checkout-service tonight during the 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. Starting traffic ramp: 10% -> 30% after 10m -> 100% if stable. Pinning model version to `v2.3.1` on the green pool. Please ack and standby for checks.
Marc: Ack. I'll watch p95/p99 and error-rate dashboards. Any additional warmup hooks we should run?
Tanya: Ack from SRE. Run the cache-warm job for 5m pre-shift? I'll tail 5xx and traces. Rollback threshold: 5xx > 0.5% or error-rate spike > 2x baseline.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by Lia. Plan: [10%, 30%, 100%]. Canary warmup: `cache-warm --service checkout-service --dur 5m`. Runbook: https://intranet/runbooks/checkout-service-shift.
June: I'll silence noisy infra alerts for the window and monitor infra alarms. Leaving pager escalation unchanged.
Sam-Platform: Note: session cookie `sid` is sticky. If users persist on blue, we may see partial traffic skew. Option: `routerctl set-affinity checkout-service none` during shift to avoid sticky sessions but that will drop some sessions. Recommend we keep affinity and accept dyeing traffic.
Carlos: Quick check — green instances warmed with current config, healthcheck 200 OK. Ready on my side.
Ops-bot: [monitor] p95 latency baseline 98ms, error-rate baseline 0.12%.
Lia: Starting step 1 -> 10% now. @deploy-bot please execute.
deploy-bot: Step 1 started: setting weight green=10% for checkout-service. Command: `routerctl set-weight checkout-service green 10`
Carlos: Confirming traffic: ~10% in us-west and eu-west within 60s. p95 +4ms.
Tanya: No 5xx from logs so far. Traces look clean.
Ops-bot: [monitor] p95 103ms, error-rate 0.13% — within expected range.
Lia: Proceeding to step 2 -> 30% in 10m if stable.
(10 minutes pass)
deploy-bot: Proceeding to step 2: setting weight green=30%
Ops-bot: [alert] error-rate rising: 5xx rate 0.9% in the last 1m — above rollback threshold.
Tanya: Seeing spike correlated with checkout.paymentCall timeouts. Traces show increased latency hitting payment-proxy around the green variant.
Marc: Rolling back now to avoid user impact. Lia, initiating rollback to blue.
Lia: Rollback acked — @deploy-bot revert weights to previous (blue 100%).
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. Executing: `routerctl set-weight checkout-service green 0` -> blue 100%.
Ops-bot: [monitor] post-rollback p95 101ms, error-rate 0.15%.
Carlos: Rollback completed and verified. All traffic at blue. No lingering 5xx.
Tanya: I'll keep tracing session on payment-proxy. Creating bug: PAYMENT-435 to capture the regression and trace artifacts.
Lia: Thanks team. We'll hold on this release, add payment-proxy timeout bump + circuit-breaker patch, then re-run shadow tests. Updating release notes and pausing the change window. https://intranet/releases/checkout-v2.3.1
Marc: +1. Recommend a dry-run in canary region with synthetic traffic before another ramp.
June: I'll schedule a 1-hour follow-up for postmortem and next attempt.
Lia: Everyone ack please so I can close the rollout.
Marc: ack
Tanya: ack
Carlos: ack
Sam-Platform: ack
Lia: Closing this rollout. We'll re-open once PAYMENT-435 is addressed. :white_check_mark:
